suitability.rationale: Directly proposes the requested MER-expressing BaF3 cellular viability endpoint, supports the ATP readout with supplied assay descriptions, and explicitly limits proliferation and target-specific conclusions. Baseline and orthogonal counts are justified adaptations.
response_quotes: This is an ATP-associated viable-cell endpoint, not a direct measurement of proliferation rate or Mer kinase activity.

procedural_soundness.rationale: Coherent preparation, exposure, detection and analysis outline includes intended background, interference, reference and baseline controls. Essential culture, detection and control implementation settings remain unresolved, as explicitly acknowledged; this is not an executable protocol.
response_quotes: reagent_volume, mix_time, stabilization_time, plate format and reader settings: unresolved.

numerical_soundness.rationale: Honest abstention leaves all concentration-series fields null, so no quantitative series can be assessed. Two-day exposure is supported by retained descriptions; three independent experiments with duplicate wells and the fit model are explicitly assumptions. No material arithmetic contradiction is present.
response_quotes: Top concentration, dilution factor and point count are null because neither CHEMBL169390 solubility nor a justified cellular dose range is supplied.

not_assessable_components: Compatibility of the exact MER construct and cellular context with the retained assay is not established.
Optimal cell density, medium, cytokine regimen, temperature and solvent tolerance are unsupported and unresolved.
Detection operating conditions, control identities and concentrations, and a qualified compound concentration range are not supplied.
assumption_handling: Clearly separates sourced two-day CellTiter-Glo assay context from proposed replication, curve fitting and orthogonal enumeration assumptions. Explicitly discloses unresolved settings and avoids predicting query-compound potency from other compounds.

numeric_check.notes: Concentration series explicitly withheld; no endpoints to calculate. Three independent cultures with duplicate technical wells mean six wells per concentration across experiments, not six biological replicates. Two days agrees with supplied descriptions.

review_reason: Exact assay compatibility and essential culture, detection, control and range-qualification conditions require domain review before execution.
